title: Privacy Policy
description: Review the types of analytics, cookies and third-party services that may be used on CounterCrave.
summary: This starter privacy page explains the website's planned analytics and affiliate data flows and must be legally reviewed before launch.

sections.heading: Information the site may collect
paragraphs: The website may process basic technical information such as browser type, device type, approximate region, referring page, viewed pages and interaction events.
Contact information is collected only when a visitor voluntarily submits it.

sections.heading: Analytics and affiliate services
paragraphs: The implementation supports Google Analytics, Vercel Analytics and Amazon affiliate links. These providers may process information under their own privacy terms.
Cookie consent or additional disclosures may be required depending on the visitor's location and the final services enabled.

sections.heading: Before production launch
paragraphs: Replace this starter text with a policy reviewed for the business entity, target markets, enabled analytics, consent system, contact process and data-retention practices.

faqs.question: What matters most when buying CounterCrave privacy policy?
faqs.answer: Capacity, footprint, and cleanup. Confirm dimensions and accessories on the Amazon listing because bundles can change by seller.

faqs.question: Does CounterCrave show live prices?
faqs.answer: No. We link to Amazon so you can check current pricing, shipping, and stock with our disclosed Associates tags.

faqs.question: How often are pages updated?
faqs.answer: Priority commercial pages are refreshed when ASINs change, models retire, or a clearer fit appears for the same use case.
